subject.title: Add structured process events for sessions

question: Should OpenClaw add a generic session-level process/step event contract now, and what event schema plus replay/security boundary should be canonical?
rationale: The requested shape would become a public Gateway/session event contract and may expose intermediate run metadata, so automation cannot safely choose the schema or security boundary.

options.title: Define generic process events
options.body: Add a core process/step event contract with explicit redaction, authorization, ordering, and replay semantics, then map existing agent/tool/item events into it where appropriate.

options.title: Extend existing streams only
options.body: Keep using session.message, session.tool, session.operation, and agent item events, and document why process.* and step.* are not a separate contract.

options.title: Defer to narrower progress issues
options.body: Leave this issue open as design backlog and solve only specific UI/CLI progress surfaces such as inter-session progress or stdout streaming first.

recommendation.title: Define generic process events
recommendation.body: Add a core process/step event contract with explicit redaction, authorization, ordering, and replay semantics, then map existing agent/tool/item events into it where appropriate.

likelyOwner.reason: The current Gateway/session event surface and protocol schema history most directly points to this area.
